title: FlowerOS Usage-Layer Pivot Finalization
objective: Finish the operator-facing boundary needed to pivot from LeafOS infrastructure development into daily FlowerOS usage without renaming or weakening the LeafOS execution and evidence contracts.
constraints: FlowerOS is the operator-facing surface and LeafOS remains the execution and evidence engine.
Stack means all downloaded and locally available models within this instance.
Dollar values are explicit gross cloud-equivalent comparisons, never unqualified net savings.
Historical benchmark and telemetry artifacts remain readable.
The TUI and Home remain read-only projections and gain no scheduler or execution authority.
Do not display or persist private model chain-of-thought.
acceptance: PowerShell and Bash FlowerOS entrypoints reach the existing LeafOS command engine.
One operator contract controls surface identity and the output-token comparison assumption.
Benchmark cells and summaries separate measured generated tokens from decode-only hourly projections.
New universal telemetry records interval-scoped local-token value while old records remain valid.
Home and the TUI show FlowerOS surface identity, LeafOS engine identity, benchmark status, and local-token value.
Focused and complete Python suites pass.
